source_title: ArcelorMittal to halt Ukraine plant after strikes
quote: ArcelorMittal said on Friday it will halt operations at its Ukrainian plant after four missile strikes in five weeks killed five workers and injured 17, triggering a roughly $1 billion non-cash impairment charge.

source_title: ArcelorMittal to halt Ukraine plant after strikes
quote: The latest strike hit the plant on Sept. 21, following attacks on Aug. 17 and Sept. 14. One of the 17 injured employees remains in critical condition.

source_title: ArcelorMittal to halt Ukraine plant after strikes
quote: The company has provided more than $700 million to its Kryvyi Rih subsidiary since Russia's invasion of Ukraine began in February 2022.

source_title: ArcelorMittal to halt Ukraine plant after strikes
quote: ArcelorMittal said it was discussing the site's future with the Ukrainian government and would preserve the infrastructure to keep open the option of restarting production when conditions allow.

source_title: Unions at Chile's Escondida mine reject bid to pause contract talks after worker's death
quote: Unions at Chile's Escondida copper mine, the world's largest, pushed back on Friday after management sought to pause contract talks with unionized supervisors and staff following a fatal accident earlier this week.

source_title: Unions at Chile's Escondida mine reject bid to pause contract talks after worker's death
quote: The unions rejected the request, meaning talks will continue on schedule.

source_title: Unions at Chile's Escondida mine reject bid to pause contract talks after worker's death
quote: Unionized supervisors are due to vote from September 28 to September 30 on the company's latest contract offer.

source_title: Unions at Chile's Escondida mine reject bid to pause contract talks after worker's death
quote: Operations at Escondida, in Chile's northern Atacama Desert, were halted after the accident, then gradually resumed on Thursday while the causes remained under investigation.

source_title: Brazil court blocks Braskem funding for Mexican unit's US bankruptcy plan
quote: A Sao Paulo bankruptcy judge ordered Brazilian petrochemicals major Braskem to immediately halt payments and guarantees supporting the US Chapter 11 restructuring of its Mexican subsidiary, polyethylene (PE) producer Braskem Idesa.

source_title: Brazil court blocks Braskem funding for Mexican unit's US bankruptcy plan
quote: The support package involves commitments worth about $800 million.

source_title: Brazil court blocks Braskem funding for Mexican unit's US bankruptcy plan
quote: Braskem Idesa is a joint venture between Braskem (75% stake) and Mexico's Grupo Idesa (with the remaining 25%).

source_title: Brazil court blocks Braskem funding for Mexican unit's US bankruptcy plan
quote: The judge also gave Braskem 15 days to file a detailed report on the operation's origin, consideration and impact.

source_title: Ukraine says it struck Russian oil refinery as drone attacks intensify
quote: Ukraine said it struck Russia's Ilsky oil refinery in the Black Sea region of Krasnodar overnight, setting the facility ablaze as both countries reported large-scale drone attacks, Bloomberg reported.

source_title: Ukraine says it struck Russian oil refinery as drone attacks intensify
quote: Three people were killed and two injured in the incident, according to the Krasnodar region's operational headquarters.

source_title: Ukraine says it struck Russian oil refinery as drone attacks intensify
quote: The Ilsky refinery is located about 850 kilometres southeast of Kyiv and has a design capacity of roughly 6.6 million tons annually.

source_title: Ukraine says it struck Russian oil refinery as drone attacks intensify
quote: Fuel supply disruptions have prompted Russian authorities to temporarily restrict most exports of gasoline, diesel and jet fuel.
